title: [UI Automata / OculOS / DirectShell / Talon] AI Desktop Automation Competitors — 2026-04 HN Survey
steps: UI AUTOMATA (https://automata.visioncortex.org): Windows UIA-based AI agent automation. Direct WKAppBot competitor. WKAppBot advantages: self-healing DYN-A11Y, 5-tier fallback (UIA->Vision->OCR->Claude->Coordinate), MCP integration, Slack loop. Benchmark when evaluating automation reliability claims.

AGENT-DESKTOP (https://github.com/lahfir/agent-desktop, seen 2026-05-06): Native Rust CLI for desktop automation over OS accessibility trees. Compare against WKAppBot a11y/grap on deterministic refs, progressive shallow snapshot plus drill-down, AX-first action fallback chain, structured JSON error codes with recovery hints, and FFI option to avoid fork-per-call overhead.

OCULOS UPDATE (https://github.com/huseyinstif/oculos, seen 2026-05-06): REST API + MCP desktop automation over OS accessibility trees, session-scoped element IDs, dashboard inspector/recorder/WebSocket events, and Windows/macOS/Linux backends. Compare against WKAppBot on fallback tiers, command surface, dashboard recorder, and MCP setup friction.
